snippet.title: Scratchin' Melodii - Stir & Mix (Lucid Mode Gameplay Preview)
snippet.description:
Here's a new look at Stir & Mix in my game, Scratchin' Melodii. This time, I'm showcasing some new vocals and the new Lucid mechanic. If you freestyle well enough on two consecutive lines, you'll ascend into Lucid Mode! (Previously known as "3D Mode" by some)

Wishlist Scratchin' Melodii on Steam here!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2728050/Scratchin_Melodii/

Credits:
Music, Art, Animation, Etc - LJ LephemStar
Vocal Tuning/Mixing - Mia (2cada)
